title: BUG: global session/key arrays have no mutex — unsafe for concurrent callers
description: PKCS#11 2.40 Section 6.7.2 requires implementations to be thread-safe when CKF_OS_LOCKING_OK is set or when OS primitives are provided. g_sessions[], g_keys[], and g_initialized in wp11_pkcs11.c are unprotected globals. Two threads calling C_OpenSession concurrently can claim the same slot. C_Login iterates all sessions without a lock, racing with concurrent C_Sign calls. Fix: wrap all access to g_sessions/g_keys/g_initialized with a single global mutex. Document the locking model in a comment at the top of wp11_pkcs11.c.
